user.title: Set up Domus UI
user.description: Add Domus UI to the sidebar. It uses the current Home Assistant account for identity, permissions and commands.

start_irrigation_zone.name: Start irrigation zone
start_irrigation_zone.description: Starts or queues a zone with a server-side safety timer.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Stable zone identifier configured in Domus UI.

duration_min.name: Duration
duration_min.description: Duration in minutes; the configured zone duration is used when omitted.

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Optional idempotency key for external clients and automations.

stop_irrigation_zone.name: Stop irrigation zone
stop_irrigation_zone.description: Closes one zone and cancels its session.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Stable zone identifier configured in Domus UI.

pause_irrigation.name: Pause irrigation
pause_irrigation.description: Closes active zones and preserves their remaining time.

stop_all_irrigation.name: Stop all irrigation
stop_all_irrigation.description: Closes all zones, clears the queue and stops schedules.

irrigation_close_failed.title: Irrigation zone did not close
irrigation_close_failed.description: Domus Core could not confirm that {zone} closed after multiple attempts ({reason}). Check the actuator and close the water supply manually if necessary.
